# Package M: completed Helsinki 1979 v3 endpoint

V3 fails four of five frozen release criteria. On **80 fresh rows across three sections, excluding both earlier samples**, it has 71 accepted crops, 71 correct numbers, 72 classifications, 72 counts, 38 top-one and 62 top-five whole rows. Random-page numbered recall passes at 1,289/1,289. Every proposal remains quarantined; zero are released. [Frozen metrics](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json), `summary`, `negative_result_criteria`.

| Outcome, Wilson 95% interval | First: 60 numbered rows, PDF 31–79 | V2: 80 rows, three sections | V3: 80 fresh rows, three sections |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crop acceptance | 23/60 (38.3%; 27.1–51.0%) | 44/80 (55.0%; 44.1–65.4%) | 71/80 (88.8%; 80.0–94.0%) |
| Drawing-unit count | 33/60 (55.0%; 42.5–66.9%) | 59/80 (73.8%; 63.2–82.1%) | 72/80 (90.0%; 81.5–94.8%) |
| Literal inscription number | 23/60 (38.3%; 27.1–51.0%) | 62/80 (77.5%; 67.2–85.3%) | 71/80 (88.8%; 80.0–94.0%) |
| Five-position classification | 19/60 (31.7%; 21.3–44.2%) | 55/80 (68.8%; 57.9–77.8%) | 72/80 (90.0%; 81.5–94.8%) |
| Whole row, top one | 13/60 (21.7%; 13.1–33.6%) | 20/80 (25.0%; 16.8–35.5%) | 38/80 (47.5%; 36.9–58.3%) |
| Whole row, top five | 24/60 (40.0%; 28.6–52.6%) | 40/80 (50.0%; 39.3–60.7%) | 62/80 (77.5%; 67.2–85.3%) |
| Exact singleton-reference sequence | 10/52 (19.2%; 10.8–31.9%) | 19/66 (28.8%; 19.3–40.6%) | 28/54 (51.9%; 38.9–64.6%) |

The first frame is 60 numbered-section rows from PDF 31–79, with no sorted row. V2 is 80 rows across numbered/end-sorted/beginning-sorted sections (28/26/26). V3 is 80 fresh rows across those sections (28/26/26), excluding all earlier target pages and development pages, from 572/2,004/2,004 eligible occurrences. These frames and references differ. Exact-sequence subsets contain 52/66/54 singleton-reference rows. [REPORT.md](REPORT.md) gives unit recall, calibration, source-count intervals and their denominators.

| V3 frozen criterion, all 80 rows unless stated | Observed | Minimum passing numerator | Additional passing rows needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crop ≥90% | 71/80 | 72/80 | 1 |
| Number ≥90% | 71/80 | 72/80 | 1 |
| Count ≥95% | 72/80 | 76/80 | 4 |
| Top-five whole rows ≥80% | 62/80 | 64/80 | 2 |
| Random-page numbered recall ≥95% | 1289/1289 | 1225/1289 | 0 |

V3 random-page numbered recall and precision are 1,289/1,289 (Wilson 95% 99.7–100%). Physical-line recall and precision are 1,296/1,296 (99.7–100%); stress-page numbered and physical recall/precision are 561/561 (99.3–100%). The count frame is 18 fresh random pages plus stress 62, 129, 130; the latter remain development pages for recognition. [Metrics](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json), `source_row_recall`, `physical_line_recall`.

The 18 top-five failures begin at 8 crops, 7 segmentation/underline defects and 3 unresolved strict-reference rows; no resolved graphic-proposal miss remains on the inspected correct windows. Numbers or classifications fail in 15/80 rows, overlapping those stages. Three chart-label differences appear in reference or proposal cells; the frozen card vocabulary is preserved, and [package P](../2026-10-08-chart-reference-audit/PROTOCOL.md) owns correction. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json); [window audit](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/unit-window-audit.json); [REPORT.md](REPORT.md).

## Proposals and verification

The full inventory contains **11,769 physical-line proposals, 11,702 numbered occurrences, 67 continuations and 54,384 unit windows**, including five unresolved empty windows, across 159 pages(PDF 22–180). All remain quarantined. [Full summary](repair/2026-10-08-v3/full-summary.json), `rows`, `units`, `released_rows`; [HOST-FILES.txt](HOST-FILES.txt) lists the 106,190,599-byte local JSONL for coordinator backup.

[Package N's pilot](../2026-10-08-helsinki1979-row-verification/pilot/PILOT-RESULTS.md) recommends a second pilot with v3 proposals, clarified conventions and P's reviewed chart before a full verification run. It has not established the human/expert acceptance route. Use the immutable [option-B contract](OPTION-B-INTERFACE.md) and [schema](option-b-schema.json), preserving physical-line keys, coordinates, continuation links, literal suffixes and source/freeze hashes. Complete source-page review must recover omissions and resolve continuation ownership. L's reviewed identity/surface joins remain separate. Release requires a new validated acceptance rule or a fresh pipeline passing every frozen criterion plus its per-row rule.

The 80 v2 rows were used for v3 development, giving 71 counts, 69 numbers, 67 classifications, 33 top-one and 60 top-five rows. They selected the method and remain Exploratory. [Development diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-development-record-v1/diagnosis.json). Both older frozen endpoints and the frozen v3 files are unchanged.

## Repeat the small record from the repository root

```powershell
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'
& 'C:\Users\sandh\.venvs\indus-ml\Scripts\python.exe' experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/record_v3_endpoint.py --out experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/review/v3-endpoint-record-repeat
& 'C:\Users\sandh\.venvs\indus-ml\Scripts\python.exe' experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/evaluate_crop_v3.py --out experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/review/v3-evaluation-repeat
& 'C:\Users\sandh\.venvs\indus-ml\Scripts\python.exe' experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/verify_v3_endpoint_record.py --out experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/review/v3-record-check-repeat.json
python tools/review_prose.py --path experiments/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization --no-write
```

Use new output paths; scripts refuse to overwrite prior runs. The evaluator replay is byte-identical to the coordinator's metrics. `inspect_v3_endpoint.py` renders ten small source/window overlays into a new local raw directory; `audit_v3_endpoint_windows.py` records the observed failure cases. `write_v3_endpoint_docs.py` regenerates these living documents from aggregates and their pre-record snapshots. Earlier inference and packet construction commands remain in the [preserved previous README](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/documentation-snapshot.json).

The [preservation check](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/preservation-check.json) covers 520 frozen witnesses; [verification](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/verification-final.json) also checks replay, stage partitions, chart uses and costs. Inspect row 31's seven shifted unit windows, the six accepted-crop count failures, unresolved rows 3/35/70 and the row 58 chart locator conflict. Every path changed for this follow-up is listed in [changed-paths.json](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/changed-paths.json).

Source attribution: Kimmo Koskenniemi and Asko Parpola, *Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script* (1979), Research Reports 1, Department of Asian and African Studies, University of Helsinki; [handle](http://hdl.handle.net/10138/342677), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Source crops, proposals and annotations are modifications. Raw renders and large exports remain local. [sources.json](sources.json) records access and rights; this follow-up downloaded nothing and changed no shared repository file.

# Helsinki 1979: the completed v3 crop evaluation

V3 fails four of five frozen release criteria. In **80 fresh rows across the numbered, end-sorted and beginning-sorted sections (28/26/26), excluding both earlier samples by page**, it accepts 71 crops, reads 71 numbers and 72 classifications, matches 72 counts, and yields 38 top-one and 62 top-five compatible whole rows. Random-page numbered recall passes at 1,289/1,289. Cropping and unit segmentation still limit the proposals; every occurrence remains quarantined. [Frozen metrics](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json), `summary`, `negative_result_criteria`; [diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `criterion_row_gaps`, `incompatible_whole_row_partitions`.

## Three frozen endpoints and their frames

| Outcome, Wilson 95% interval | First: 60 numbered rows, PDF 31–79 | V2: 80 rows, three sections | V3: 80 fresh rows, three sections |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crop acceptance | 23/60 (38.3%; 27.1–51.0%) | 44/80 (55.0%; 44.1–65.4%) | 71/80 (88.8%; 80.0–94.0%) |
| Drawing-unit count | 33/60 (55.0%; 42.5–66.9%) | 59/80 (73.8%; 63.2–82.1%) | 72/80 (90.0%; 81.5–94.8%) |
| Literal inscription number | 23/60 (38.3%; 27.1–51.0%) | 62/80 (77.5%; 67.2–85.3%) | 71/80 (88.8%; 80.0–94.0%) |
| Five-position classification | 19/60 (31.7%; 21.3–44.2%) | 55/80 (68.8%; 57.9–77.8%) | 72/80 (90.0%; 81.5–94.8%) |
| Whole row, top one | 13/60 (21.7%; 13.1–33.6%) | 20/80 (25.0%; 16.8–35.5%) | 38/80 (47.5%; 36.9–58.3%) |
| Whole row, top five | 24/60 (40.0%; 28.6–52.6%) | 40/80 (50.0%; 39.3–60.7%) | 62/80 (77.5%; 67.2–85.3%) |
| Exact singleton-reference sequence | 10/52 (19.2%; 10.8–31.9%) | 19/66 (28.8%; 19.3–40.6%) | 28/54 (51.9%; 38.9–64.6%) |

The first endpoint contains **60 numbered-section rows from PDF 31–79**, drawn from 3,460 of the original 11,369 detections, with no sorted-section target. V2 contains **80 rows across three sections (28/26/26)** with eligible pools 3,596/3,228/3,496. V3 contains **80 fresh rows across those sections (28/26/26)** from pools 572/2,004/2,004 on 8/28/28 eligible pages. V3 excludes every page carrying any first-60 or v2-80 target and the original ten development pages. The row comparisons have different source frames and references; they do not estimate a paired crop-repair effect or a section-weighted edition rate. [First metrics](evaluation/2026-10-07-frozen-v1/metrics.json), `summary`; [v2 metrics](repair/2026-10-07-v2/evaluation-2026-10-07-adjudicated/metrics.json), `frame`, `summary`; [v3 selection](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/selection.json), `denominators`, `eligible_pages`, `excluded_pages`.

The first crop figure preserves its original annotator labels, including C's permissive judgments; the separate objective audit and later reference corrections remain in the [preserved earlier report](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/documentation-snapshot.json). Exact-sequence denominators retain only singleton-reference rows: 52, 66, 54. V3 has 369 reference units and 374 proposals; 28 units retain multiple strict candidates and three have empty strict sets. Those three rows remain in the 80-row whole-sequence denominator. The fully resolved-reference sensitivity is 62/77 top-five rows (80.5%; 70.3–87.8%), while the frozen criterion uses 62/80. [V3 metrics](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json), `summary.reference_*`, `summary.strict_top5`.

| V3 frozen criterion, all 80 rows unless stated | Observed | Minimum passing numerator | Additional passing rows needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crop ≥90% | 71/80 | 72/80 | 1 |
| Number ≥90% | 71/80 | 72/80 | 1 |
| Count ≥95% | 72/80 | 76/80 | 4 |
| Top-five whole rows ≥80% | 62/80 | 64/80 | 2 |
| Random-page numbered recall ≥95% | 1289/1289 | 1225/1289 | 0 |

The criterion gaps count passing rows required at the frozen point thresholds; they are not promises that repairing that many rows would validate a future method. The classification field and top-one sequence have reported scores but no separate global threshold. All four failures keep the global release gate closed. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `criterion_row_gaps`.

## Unit recall and confidence calibration

| Outcome, stored row-bootstrap 95% interval | First: same 60 numbered rows | V2: same 80 three-section rows | V3: same 80 fresh three-section rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aligned strict top-one recall | 199/267 (74.5%; 66.3–81.7%) | 249/352 (70.7%; 64.2–76.8%) | 293/366 (80.1%; 73.6–86.2%) |
| Aligned strict top-five recall | 224/267 (83.9%; 76.0–90.6%) | 304/352 (86.4%; 81.1–91.2%) | 338/366 (92.3%; 87.8–96.4%) |
| Equal-count positional top one | 103/140 (73.6%; 58.4–85.3%) | 174/252 (69.0%; 61.0–76.2%) | 263/315 (83.5%; 77.0–88.9%) |
| Equal-count positional top five | 118/140 (84.3%; 68.7–95.7%) | 217/252 (86.1%; 79.2–92.1%) | 301/315 (95.6%; 91.6–98.8%) |
| Brier score | 0.1488 (0.107–0.197) | 0.1925 (0.158–0.231) | 0.1117 (0.095–0.131) |
| Ten-bin calibration error | 0.1056 (0.080–0.185) | 0.0755 (0.047–0.147) | 0.1153 (0.090–0.151) |

Aligned recall counts resolved strict units: the three v3 empty sets leave 366 of 369 units in that denominator. Extra proposals do not reduce aligned recall; their effects enter count and whole-row scores. Positional scores and calibration are conditional on equal counts and resolved strict positions (315 v3 units). V3 kept the original confidence coefficients and performed no refit. Its 43 units in the ≥0.9 confidence bin all match top one, within this conditional sample; that bin provides no row-release authorization. The stored v3 intervals use 2,000 row resamples within sections, seed 2026100881. [Three metric files](evaluation/2026-10-07-frozen-v1/metrics.json), [v2](repair/2026-10-07-v2/evaluation-2026-10-07-adjudicated/metrics.json), [v3](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json), `summary`, `row_bootstrap_95`, `bootstrap`.

## Source-row and physical-line recall

| Independent count frame | V2 recall / precision, pooled Wilson 95% | V3 recall / precision, pooled Wilson 95% |
|---|---|---|
| 18 random pages, six per section | 1,242/1,286 (96.6%; 95.4–97.4%) / 1,242/1,242 (100%; 99.7–100%) | 1,289/1,289 for both (100%; 99.7–100%) |
| Stress pages 62, 129, 130 | 561/561 for both (100%; 99.3–100%) | 561/561 for both (100%; 99.3–100%) |
| Random-page physical lines, including unnumbered lines | Not a frozen v2 metric | 1,296/1,296 for both (100%; 99.7–100%) |

V3's 18 random pages are fresh relative to the previous count-page set. Its seven extra physical lines occur on pages 35, 47,127,172 and 175. Both readers agree on 1,850 numbered rows and 1,857 physical lines across all 21 pages and 52 columns; the stress pages contain no extra physical lines. Random-page bootstrap recall/precision intervals are 100–100% for v3, compared with 90.5–100% numbered recall for v2. A sampled zero-miss result does not establish complete edition coverage. The compact stress pages 129–130 remain development pages excluded from recognition sampling; this count test measures discovery, not sign recognition on those pages. Continuation parents in the count reference remain probable assignments to the numbered line above, supported by position rather than a printed link. [V3 metrics](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json), `source_row_recall`, `physical_line_recall`; [adjudication](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/adjudication-notes.json), `counts_comparison`; [reader B counts](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/reader-b/counts.json), `notes`.

## Limiting stages, compared with v2

Of v3's **18 incompatible top-five rows**, eight fail the crop check, six have unequal counts despite an accepted crop, and four have accepted crops and equal counts. The four are row 31 with four resolved unit misses and rows 3, 35, 70 with one empty strict-reference set each. Inspecting row 31 shows that the seven windows cut the U and adjacent fish drawings and assign overlapping underline slots. The refined diagnostic partition is therefore **8 crop, 7 segmentation/underline association, 3 unresolved strict-reference rows and 0 resolved graphic-proposal misses on inspected correct windows**. V2's corresponding inspected partition was **34 crop, 5 segmentation/underline association and 1 graphic-proposal miss** among 40 top-five failures. These are earliest observed failure stages, not counterfactual accuracy gains. [V3 diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `incompatible_whole_row_partitions`, `unresolved_strict_units`; [window audit](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/unit-window-audit.json), `refined_top5_counts`, `observations`; [v2 audit](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/unit-window-audit.json), `refined_top5_incompatible_rows`.

The six accepted-crop count failures are concrete: row 14 promotes a speck to a unit; row 32 emits an extra underline fragment and cuts a compound window; row 41 splits one tick group into three; rows 60 and 65 promote remote specks; row 68 merges two adjacent drawings. The seven inspected resolved segmentation failures include row 31's equal-count window shifts. The 65 accepted-crop, equal-count rows have 247/282 strict resolved positional matches at top one and 278/282 at top five. All four resolved top-five misses lie in row 31. Equal counts remain a proxy for the other rows' boundaries; this inspection covers failed top-five cases, not every unit. Top-one whole-row failures partition into 9 crop, 6 count and 27 count-consistent candidate failures; the last group includes the same three unresolved rows and row 31. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `count_consistent_accepted_crop_proxy`, `accepted_crop_equal_count_top5_misses`; [audit](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/unit-window-audit.json), `observations`.

The nine rejected crops comprise six with neighbour-row ink (21, 44, 48, 55, 58, 66) and three with cut drawings (30, 76, 77). Row 77 also loses an own underline; rows 76 and 77 have field boxes overlapping the final drawing. Row 30 retains a compatible top-five sequence despite its rejected crop. V2's overlapping tags named omitted own underlines in 18 rows, neighbour ink in 13, number ink in 13 and cut ink in 4. V3's residual crop problem concentrates at the lower row edge and the field boundary. The original reader strings are retained unchanged alongside these post-outcome tag families. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `crop_issues`, per-row `adjudicated_crop_issues`; [audit](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/unit-window-audit.json), `crop_tag_families`; [v2 diagnosis](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `crop_issues`.

Number reading fails in 9/80 rows and classification-field reading in 8/80, with 15/80 having at least one wrong field. Seven wrong numbers (22, 35, 40, 43, 52, 69, 73) and four wrong classifications (17, 25, 34, 57) remain within accepted-crop, equal-count rows. Those eleven rows are disjoint. V2 had 18 wrong numbers, 25 wrong classifications and 30 rows with either wrong field; its accepted-crop, equal-count subset retained three wrong numbers and seven wrong classifications. Field errors are separate from drawing-code classification. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `subsets`; [v2 diagnosis](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `subsets`.

| V3 section, frame size | Crop failures | Count failures | Top-five row failures | Number failures | Classification-field failures |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Numbered, 28 | 1 | 1 | 3 | 1 | 2 |
| End-sorted, 26 | 3 | 2 | 6 | 4 | 2 |
| Beginning-sorted, 26 | 5 | 5 | 9 | 4 | 4 |

Beginning-sorted rows contribute half the top-five failures and five of the eight count failures. Neighbour ink occurs on PDF 68, 112, 115, 135, 148, 161; drawing cuts occur on 84, 172, 174. Page 87 contributes both the equal-count underline/window failure (31) and a count failure (32). End-sorted fields lie on the left (3/26 rejected crops); the other sections use the right (6/54). Even pages have 6/44 rejected crops and odd pages 3/36. These small groups do not isolate a parity or margin-side cause. V2 had similar crop/top-five failures across its three sections (13/12/11 and 14/13/13), whereas v3's remaining failures cluster more in its sorted-section sample. No compact multi-column recognition row was evaluated. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `by_section`, `by_page`, `by_margin_side`, `by_page_parity`; [v2 diagnosis](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), corresponding fields.

## Chart labels and future correction

| Chart cell | Frozen card label / observed printed code | Reference units by exact cell key | Top-one / any top-five proposal units |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20:4:1 | 506 / 508 | 3 (31:0, 32:0, 32:2) | 2 / 3 |
| 21:6:1 | 206 / 208 | 2 (60:6, 67:4) | 2 / 6 |
| 20:4:13 | 360 / 350 | 0 | 0 / 0 |
| 21:6:31 | 285 / 286 | 0 | 0 / 1 |

The first two differences affect reference units and predictions in this sample; the fourth appears only as a non-top-one proposal (row 46 unit 1, rank 4). This endpoint scores the shared card vocabulary, so the printed-label differences do not change its frozen codes or metrics. The adjudication notes additionally locate row 58 unit 0 at 20:4:1, while the reference locates it at 21:7:5, another card labelled 506. The table uses exact reference keys and preserves that conflicting prose locator separately. It is unsafe to replace every occurrence of 506 or 206 globally because different cells share those codes. [Adjudication notes](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/adjudication-notes.json), `card_label_observations`; [diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `chart_label_audit`, `chart_location_witness_disagreement`.

Post-outcome source inspection supports the reference's row 58 locator: its first drawing is two overlapping circles with corner ticks, matching 21:7:5; 20:4:1 is a branched stem. This local observation preserves both witnesses and makes no new reference. [Locator inspection](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/chart-locator-inspection.json), `observation`, `source_hashes`.

[Package P](../2026-10-08-chart-reference-audit/PROTOCOL.md) owns the full chart audit. A future pipeline should take its reviewed, cell-keyed snapshot and explicit old-to-new mapping as new inputs, regenerate candidate-code labels and blind chart cards, retain unresolved and duplicate-code cases, and check confidence calibration under the new labels. Freeze those changes and their evaluator before a fresh source reference. Preserve this endpoint for comparison; a separate cell-remapping sensitivity can measure label effects but cannot replace its metrics. Package N's verification reference must declare its chart version and independently confirm the row 58 cell identity before using that cell-specific mapping.

## Quarantine and package N handoff

All **11,769 v3 physical-line proposals (11,702 numbered occurrences and 67 continuations) remain quarantined; zero are released**, as do the 11,369 original occurrences. The full JSONL has 54,384 unit windows, five unresolved empty windows, and 159 source pages. Its 106,190,599-byte payload stays local; [HOST-FILES.txt](HOST-FILES.txt) lists it for coordinator backup. No full inference was repeated while recording this endpoint. [Full summary](repair/2026-10-08-v3/full-summary.json), `rows`, `numbered_occurrences`, `continuation_lines`, `units`, `nonfinite_units_unresolved`, `released_rows`.

An automatic route requires a separately frozen repair and fresh blind test passing all five global criteria, then complete geometry, resolved continuation/editorial state, singleton top-one codes, independent numeric-witness agreement, minimum unit confidence 0.90 and confidence product 0.90 for each eligible row. The chart correction also needs an explicit version and label validation. High confidence cannot bypass a failed global gate. The authorized option-B route uses the v3 inventory as proposals, with complete source-column coverage, reviewed line membership and missing-line recovery; its separately validated acceptance rule and human/expert source check remain required. [Freeze](repair/2026-10-08-v3/freeze-manifest.json), `release_rule`; [proposal contract](OPTION-B-INTERFACE.md); [schema](option-b-schema.json).

[Package N's pilot](../2026-10-08-helsinki1979-row-verification/pilot/PILOT-RESULTS.md) used v2 proposals on 216 target rows: readers agreed on 185/216 (85.6%; Wilson 80.3–89.7%), and 31 went to adjudication. Each role passed 16/18 all-field hidden controls (88.9%; 67.2–96.9%), below its 95% screening threshold; adjudication matched all 18. It recommends clarified coincident-pair/unit-kind conventions, package P's reviewed chart and a second pilot with v3 before a full run. Seeing proposals saved no reader time in that pilot. Package M supplies immutable source coordinates, physical-line keys, suffix-preserving numbers, candidate sets, confidence and source/freeze hashes through the [option-B interface](OPTION-B-INTERFACE.md); N creates its own reviewed records under its [input contract](../2026-10-08-helsinki1979-row-verification/INPUT_CONTRACT.md). The original proposals and endpoint stay unchanged.

N's measured planning projection for two AI roles plus adjudication on 11,702 numbered occurrences is 336.4 million task tokens (bootstrap 95% 302.2–366.1 million) and 346.0 summed agent-hours (276.1–462.3), before an unmeasured human/expert pass. Task tokens include cached context and are not a price. The pilot is three pages, so those planning intervals do not measure full-edition verification accuracy. A person checking every numbered occurrence would add 195.0,390.1 or 975.2 hours at assumed one, two orfive minutes per row, plus continuation, source-coverage and ledger work; human throughput has not been observed. [N projection](../2026-10-08-helsinki1979-row-verification/pilot/coordinator-cost-projection-v1.json), `full_run`; [cost record](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/reader-process-cost.json), `package_n_pilot`. L still requires independently reviewed carrier/surface concordances and imports none here.

## Development, provenance and reproduction

V3 reused all 80 v2 targets and 352 units, and 21 old count pages, to select its crop method before freezing. Development scores were 71 counts, 69 numbers, 67 classifications, 33 top-one and 60 top-five rows,327/352 aligned top-five units, and 1,847/1,847 numbered recall. These Exploratory development results remain in the [development diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-development-record-v1/diagnosis.json); they are separate from the fresh endpoint above. The old classifier, digits, chart and calibration were reused unchanged. The [freeze](repair/2026-10-08-v3/freeze-manifest.json) and [prediction freeze](repair/2026-10-08-v3/prediction-freeze.json) precede all new readings. The complete reader/adjudication process and deviations are recorded in [RETROSPECTIVE.md](RETROSPECTIVE.md) and [reader cost](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/reader-process-cost.json).

The new record reuses `record_repaired_endpoint.py`'s Wilson and diagnostic functions, the v2 diagnosis and window audit, the frozen scorer and all supplied reader witnesses. Reproduction commands are in [README.md](README.md). Source attribution: Kimmo Koskenniemi and Asko Parpola, *Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script* (1979), University of Helsinki, [handle](http://hdl.handle.net/10138/342677), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); raster cropping and annotations are modifications. No new source download, literature search, chart correction or ledger import was performed.

# V3 cropping work, 8 October 2026

The new work produces a frozen source-only packet and 11,769 physical-line proposals, 11,702 numbered occurrences, 67 continuation lines and 54,384 proposed unit windows (5 unresolved) across 159 pages (PDF 22–180), all quarantined. Development reuses the 80 v2 targets and all 21 existing count pages; no reader was asked to annotate the fresh packet. The coordinator will run both independent readers and adjudication. Their future timing, billed cost and deviations are unknown. [Full summary](repair/2026-10-08-v3/full-summary.json); [development record](repair/2026-10-08-development-record-v1/diagnosis.json).

Initial print-line clustering merged number/classification bands and located only 9/80 targets in trial v 3a. Subsequent component-center pairing and repeated horizontal-field bounds located all 80 targets. Trials v 3a–v 3h remain in separate development directories; their JSONs and source inspection renders are preserved. Trial v 3e finished while the crop source file had been edited, so its end-of-run code hash does not identify the loaded module. It is a diagnostic trial with incomplete code provenance. Final v 3h captures the starting hash and confirms that the implementation stayed unchanged during the run. The freeze uses only v 3h. [Final development](repair/2026-10-08-development-v3h/development.json), `code_sha256`, `code_unchanged_during_run`, `summary`; [trial v3e](repair/2026-10-08-development-v3e/development.json).

Source inspection found that a field search window could cut a drawing into small components that looked like digits. Excluding those clipped components and masking actual field bounds improved several page fields. Whole underline slots were restored after body segmentation, fixing the five named segmentation/association rows. Known rows 27/53/76 geometry defects remain, and the inherited matcher still proposes incorrect graphic variants on some complete units. No model, chart label or calibration was refitted. [Development inspection](repair/2026-10-08-development-record-v1/visual-inspection.json); [diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-development-record-v1/diagnosis.json).

The stronger page exclusion resolves ambiguous old inverted or two-line target geometry and leaves 8/28/28 eligible section pages. The seeded sample has 80 targets and no detected continuation; the 21 fresh count pages therefore request both numbered and physical-line centers. The conventions add continuation-membership checks, the 597/598 neighbouring-cell rule and unique reader scratch directories. This task used one working process per script and no shared annotator helper; no fresh reader/adjudicator cost was incurred by this package. Earlier reader timing/deviations remain in the preserved record below.

The full run first completed 17 pages in 254.0 recorded seconds, then stopped on page 39 when strict JSON export rejected a non-finite score from an empty two-pixel unit window. Completed page files and the partial page 39 output are preserved. A separately recorded transport helper continued unchanged inference, marking 5 invalid unit windows unresolved with empty alternatives and null confidence, and retaining their original payloads as local string-valued witnesses. The resumed pass records 3068.2 seconds; failed-page time was not separately measured. [Transport manifest](repair/2026-10-08-v3/full-transport-manifest.json); [full summary](repair/2026-10-08-v3/full-summary.json), `reused_pages`, `original_completed_inference_seconds`, `seconds`, `nonfinite_units_unresolved`.

Available disk space before the large run was 135,483,957,248 bytes. The coordinator withdrew the 500 MB cap; source inspection renders and full page payloads stay local. Output is 106,190,599 bytes, listed with its hash and page files for coordinator backup. No backup, publication, ledger mutation or repository-history action was performed. [Full summary](repair/2026-10-08-v3/full-summary.json), `bytes`, `path`, `sha256`; [HOST-FILES.txt](HOST-FILES.txt).

Incorrect-cwd read-only lookups returned missing-file errors and were corrected using the repository/package root. No source download, web search, package installation or new concordance acquisition was attempted. The existing PDF, original recognizer, digit library, chart snapshot, source-count reference and frozen evaluators were reused. Old frozen outputs are covered by the preservation checks in [verification.json](repair/2026-10-08-record-v1/verification.json). The prose scan and transport/schema checks are recorded there; fresh accuracy and edition-wide completeness remain for the coordinator and option-B package.

## Earlier process record, preserved

# Retrospective: Helsinki 1979 digitization

The first pipeline failed its frozen test of **60 numbered-section rows from PDF 31–79 (3,460/11,369 detected occurrences; no sorted target)**: 33 matching counts, 23 exact numbers and 24 top-five compatible whole rows. The full first run preserved 11,369 provisional occurrences across 159 pages. Its source witnesses, predictions, references and numerical endpoints remain unchanged. Original prose is retained in `follow-up/2026-10-07/*.before-follow-up.txt`.

## First run and review evidence

The first run replaced fixed vertical pitch with observed number bands and glyph whitespace, reused the 687-cell chart and known page-30 reference, and combined sparse chamfer distances with chart-only CNN augmentation. A dense development matcher was interrupted for speed; a sparse implementation was frozen before source reading. The final development counts were 17/20 with 6/20 and 12/20 top-one/five whole rows. Static horizontal regions and a density-based orientation score remained.

Three readers supplied disjoint primary groups; original OCR strings accidentally remained in 22 locators. Those strings were removed from a separate copy, exposure was disclosed and the initial references retained. Six fixed convenience repeats, two per primary group, exposed glyph and crop disagreements; no random selection rule was recorded.

The Sonnet review confirmed 43 headline numbers and independently matched 30 source rows for count, number and classification. It found all 17 rotated pages upright, 1,223 inverted strips, asymmetric field drift and missing/fragmented crops. A/B accepted 7/40 crops; C accepted 16/20, including nine with objective defects under a 1-point tolerance. The objective audits pass 14/60 and 21/60 with that tolerance in the same original numbered-section frame. These results are appended as corrections, not substituted into the frozen evaluation.

## Coordinator corrections, 7 October 2026

Copied the frozen prediction bytes into an owned portable input root, retained digits/crops/chart sheets, listed tracking exceptions and added a retrospective evaluator-hash supplement. Two portable replays match the original metrics SHA 256 exactly. Replaced the active universal queue with 9,584 triaged rows, retaining 1,785 outside triage and all 11,369 in quarantine. The separate orientation overlay flags all 1,223 inverted occurrences. The row-recall record lists 20 short pages, page 62 column 0's 21 detections against 36 printed rows and the compact multi-column pages 129–130.

The review's eleven code corrections are a dated overlay. Codes 2/25 need vertical position; narrow/wide hatching and underlines need separate labels. Original references were not edited. Calibration excluding three inverted selected rows uses 126 positions and yields Brier 0.1262 and ten-bin error 0.1183, with row-bootstrap intervals, without refitting or applying adjudications. These are Exploratory sensitivities of the original numbered-section frame.

## Repair attempts and preserved problems

The layout repair measures field coordinates from OCR boxes and print components, keeps pages upright from header content, and detects observed row bands without fixed counts. The first compact-column attempt discarded columns where no field/glyph gap was visible; retaining those columns with a flagged page-level gap estimate produced eight columns/288 rows on page 129 and six/201 on 130. An OCR batch exceeding Tesseract's image-height limit failed; batches of 96 rows fixed it. Development page 30 has 17/20 matching counts, 19/20 numbers, 6/20 top-one and 12/20 top-five whole rows. These are development observations.

The v1 candidate was frozen and sampled, then its unlabelled frame exposed glyph-like OCR strings as extra columns on ordinary pages. No reader received it. Its full artifacts remain under `repair/2026-10-07-v1/`, marked Superseded. The v2 replacement restricts ordinary margin clusters to a 35-point neighbourhood while retaining native compact-column discovery. Its code and evaluator were frozen at 2026-10-07T 16:54:51.431467+00:00; 80 predictions were frozen at 2026-10-07T 16:58:06.116694+00:00. The seeded frame includes 28 numbered, 26 end-sorted and 26 beginning-sorted rows, excluding development pages and previous targets. It also retains 21 source-count pages. No fresh reference or accuracy outcome existed when this package stopped; the coordinator subsequently supplied them as recorded below.

A shell-quoting attempt to prepare v2 failed before creating files; a small Python construction helper replaced it. Shared Windows volume/process queries were denied. No dependency was installed in this follow-up, and no other package or repository history was changed. The revised L importer was exercised on 63 existing occurrences, including three provisional letter-suffixed strings: all schema checks passed and all remained quarantined without concordances.

## Disk stop and exact unfinished work

The first check found 896,548,864 bytes free, below the user's 1 GB cutoff. Free space subsequently recovered to about 2.65 GB and development resumed. During v2 sampling it fell to 917,327,872 and then 256,331,776 bytes. The helper had already serialized its 60,522,244-byte frame by the failed pre-frame check, and finished before interruption could take effect; CIM process inspection was denied. Space recovered after the helper exited. The cause of the fluctuations is unverified. A future gate must run inside the active process after library/model loading and immediately before each large serialization; checking outside that process was insufficient.

Further repair/evaluation work stopped at that trigger. The completed freeze, sample, predictions, positional chart cards and source-count pages are preserved. At that stop the following work remained (items 1–3 have since been completed by the coordinator):

1. Two independent readers must read all 80 rows and count/match all 21 source pages without predictions or OCR numbers.
2. A third source-only reader must adjudicate disagreements, preserving both initial readings and final source counts.
3. Run the frozen evaluator for row segmentation/counts, exact sequences, candidates, numbers, classification, row recall and calibration with intervals, beside the first endpoint and its different frame.
4. If every criterion passes, implement a fresh full transcription with an in-process disk gate and the frozen confidence release rule. If any stage fails, preserve quarantine and report the limiting stage.
5. A reviewed identity concordance and per-occurrence surface alignment are still required for actual Package L imports; the local 1980 lookup supplies no verified carrier join.

The coordinator must also apply the listed tracking exceptions before claiming clean-checkout recovery. Finish small documentation and integrity checks without starting another large write or deleting frozen evidence.

## Completed repaired evaluation, recorded 7 October 2026

The coordinator supplied six Sonnet reading files: each of readers A and B read rows 0–39, rows 40–79 and the 21 count pages. A third reader adjudicated without predictions, using page scans and the printed sign chart. The coordinator ran the unchanged frozen evaluator against the final references. All 320 row-level fields agree between readers (number, classification, unit count and crop status on all 80 rows). Strict unit sets agree in 333/352 positions; 19 disagreements span 15 rows. Both count readers agree on all 52 column counts, totaling 1,847 numbered occurrences, with ten unnumbered continuation lines recorded separately. [Initial readings](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/reader-a/rows-part1.json) and [second readings](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/reader-b/rows-part1.json), their part-2/count files; [reference](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/adjudicated-reference.json); [counts](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/adjudicated-counts.json).

The 222 adjudication notes contain 19 strict-code decisions, eight unit-kind decisions, 181 shape-only candidate-set decisions, one blank-gap distance decision and 13 count-coordinate/continuation-position decisions. Large shape-only sets reflect differing reader scope and were adjudicated separately from strict codes. The decisions preserve candidate sets for identical printed drawings. No original or repaired reference was edited during this recording. [Decision record](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/adjudication-notes.json), `field`; [agreement calculation](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `readers`.

The repaired **80-row all-section frame (28/26/26)** yields 44/80 crops, 59/80 counts, 62/80 numbers, 55/80 classifications, 20/80 top-one and 40/80 top-five whole rows. Four global criteria fail. The separate 18-page count frame recalls 1,242/1,286 rows, with all 44 misses on pages 66 and 112; stress pages recall 561/561. All occurrences remain quarantined. The [report](REPORT.md) presents intervals beside the unchanged **60 numbered-section rows on PDF 31–79** and keeps the frames distinct.

Reader notes disclose shared-scratchpad failures. A's first-row task saw two helper-script lines in an error trace after `zoom.py` was overwritten; B's second-row task ran an overwritten helper once, producing an enlarged render in B 1's temporary directory, then deleted it and isolated its scripts. B's count task read an overwritten `common.py` containing image-loading/run-merging functions but no counts or positions, then moved its scripts to a separate subdirectory. B's row tasks also listed primary-source, local-raw or scratchpad directory names without opening the prohibited contents. These departures reduce process isolation; the disclosed snippets/helpers contain no predictions or reference values, and the readers report no prediction exposure. A future protocol should assign unique helper directories before launching tasks. [A part 1](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/reader-a/rows-part1.json), [B part 1](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/reader-b/rows-part1.json), [B part 2](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/reader-b/rows-part2.json), [B counts](repair/2026-10-07-v2/blind/reader-b/counts.json), each `notes`. Temporary diagnostic overlays were deleted by the readers, so their inspection cannot be reconstructed from overlays alone; source images and final coordinates remain.

Recorded elapsed time is 13,810 seconds (230.2 minutes) for four row tasks and 2,227 seconds (37.1 minutes) for two count tasks, totaling 16,037 seconds (267.3 minutes). Their earliest start/latest finish span 5,679 seconds (94.7 minutes), with concurrent tasks and approximate start times. No adjudicator timing, token usage or billed dollars appears in the supplied files; those costs are unknown. A request for the billing witness was made during this task. The extrapolated review route needs at least 22,738 initial row readings, plus source recovery/adjudication. Human times are assumed scenarios; AI times are measured elapsed-task extrapolations. [Cost record](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/review-workload.json), `observed_reader_task_timing`, `human_scenarios`, nullable billing/adjudicator fields.

The recording helper's first attempt failed before producing output because a dictionary constructor repeated the `pdf_page` key. Removing the duplicate fixed it. Reused the existing scorer outputs, frozen predictions, source images, chart conventions and original review; no model inference, downloads or new large renders were needed. A post-outcome inspection of the five accepted-crop/equal-count top-five unit misses separates four truncated underline windows from one graphic proposal miss. The six source rows inspected are preserved in [unit-window-audit.json](follow-up/2026-10-07/endpoint-record-v1/unit-window-audit.json). Equal-count rows outside that inspection retain the stated segmentation-proxy limitation.

Remaining work is a validated release method, complete source/continuation coverage, human review and occurrence/carrier concordances. The completed failed endpoint does not authorize the proposed full repaired run. Frozen witnesses and both failed results remain available for a later separately frozen retry.


## Completed v3 endpoint, recorded 8 October 2026

The coordinator completed two independent Claude Sonnet 5.5 readings of all 80 fresh rows and 21 count pages, then a third-reader adjudication. Four 40-row tasks and two count tasks used separate source-only sessions and scratch folders. Readers rendered source pixels and compared position-chart cards under the frozen conventions; no prediction was supplied. The coordinator hash-checked all three evaluators and ran `evaluate_crop_v3.py` unchanged. This package recorded that outcome and reran the scorer into a new directory, without new inference or references. [Metrics](repair/2026-10-08-v3/evaluation-2026-10-08-adjudicated/metrics.json); [evaluator replay](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/evaluator-replay/metrics.json).

The readers agree on all 80 inscription numbers, classifications, counts and line memberships (320 fields),357/369 strict unit sets, 79/80 crop judgments and 369 underline flags. Twelve strict-set disagreements lie in 12 rows; the crop disagreement is a thirteenth row. Adjudication keeps 67/80 rows agreed on all compared fields, settles the twelve unit disagreements and rejects row 21 for a small strip of neighbour ink. It also empties the strict set for row 35 unit 2, which both readers had filled with 23: the source is a continuous high tick while that card shows a dot and gapped stroke. Three strict sets remain empty (3:5, 35:2, 70:4), and 28 remain multi-code sets. Raw unit-kind labels differ in 32/369 units and are standardized by the adjudicator. Shape-only lists use different reader conventions; after adding strict codes to both lists,165/369 agree exactly. None of those initial files was edited in this recording. [Adjudication notes](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/adjudication-notes.json), `agreement_summary`, `disagreement_summary`, `policy`; [diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `readers`.

The two count readers agree on all 52 per-column counts:1,850 numbered rows and 1,857 physical lines, including seven unnumbered continuations. Adjudication compares 3,707 centres, finds 59 differing by at least 1 pt(maximum 4 pt), and records 12 centre/extent overrides. Their continuation parents are probable preceding-line assignments, with no printed links. The 80 sampled recognition targets have one physical line each, so the count pages supply the fresh continuation-discovery evidence. [Notes](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/adjudication-notes.json), `counts_comparison`, `counts_centre_overrides`; [reader count notes](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/reader-b/counts.json).

The process has disclosed deviations. Some readers listed other role folders or, for reader B's count task, names one level above BLIND including predictions/frame files; they report opening none. Reader A part 2 used source renders up to 24 pixels per point, above the suggested working scale. Reader B part 2 stopped a hung helper append in its own scratch folder. The adjudicator opened wide context images by script without viewing those sheets, rendered original count pages instead of opening the supplied page PNGs, and used OCR only on chart-label raster strips. An unrelated-process listing exposed command lines from other projects; the adjudicator reports no experiment output exposure. It inspected 155 chart-label OCR disagreements by eye while 532 agreeing pairs had only the two OCR readings; that limited chart check is not the whole-chart audit. All readers report no prediction/other-reader exposure; these are declarations rather than independently logged access proofs. [Cost record](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/reader-process-cost.json), `reader_notes`, `adjudication_exposure`; [adjudication notes](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/adjudication-notes.json), `files_opened`, `not_opened`, `card_label_observations`, `exposure`.

The four chart-label differences remain in the frozen vocabulary. Exact reference keys show five affected units, while the prose notes additionally name row 58 unit 0 at a different cell from the reference. This record keeps both witnesses and audits proposals by template key, avoiding a global code replacement. Package P owns the chart correction. Reader schema differences(`line`/`line_index`/`line_number`, `kind`/`line_kind`, explicit counts/`unit_orders`) are normalized only for the agreement computation; raw files remain intact. [Diagnosis](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/diagnosis.json), `chart_label_audit`, `chart_location_witness_disagreement`.

| Task group | Tasks | Recorded total tokens | Summed duration, seconds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two readings of 80 rows | 4 | 1,504,484 | 7,015.358 |
| Two readings of 21 count pages | 2 | 485,109 | 1,625.756 |
| Third-reader adjudication | 1 | 497,073 | 2,467.159 |
| All tasks | 7 | 2,486,666 | 11,108.273 |

The ledger records **2,486,666 task tokens and 11,108.273 summed seconds (3.086 task-hours)** across seven tasks, including adjudication. The row tasks alone average 9,403.025 tokens and 43.846 seconds per reading across 160 readings. All tasks combined use 31,083.325 tokens per 80-row target, also carrying count-page work. These totals include input, cached-context re-reads and output and establish no billed dollar amount or human throughput. Task durations are summed, not elapsed wall time. [Coordinator ledger](repair/2026-10-08-v3/blind/coordinator-task-ledger.jsonl); [cost aggregate](repair/2026-10-08-endpoint-record-v1/reader-process-cost.json), `groups`, `row_tokens_per_reading`, `row_seconds_per_reading`.

The fresh endpoint passes source discovery but fails crop, number, count and top-five criteria by 1, 1, 4 and 2 rows respectively. The post-outcome window inspection assigns 18 top-five failures to 8 crops, 7 segmentation/underline defects and 3 unresolved-reference rows. V2's inspected counterpart was 34 crops, 5 segmentation/underline defects and 1 graphic-proposal miss. This narrows repair targets and does not release a row. Package N's separate three-page pilot projects 336.4 million tokens and 346 summed agent-hours for two AI roles plus adjudication; its first pilot failed its 95% role screening threshold. It recommends a second pilot with v3 and corrected conventions/chart. Human/expert source checks and ledger joins remain unmeasured work. [REPORT.md](REPORT.md); [N pilot](../2026-10-08-helsinki1979-row-verification/pilot/PILOT-RESULTS.md).

The recorder first failed before writing outputs because packet hash paths were treated as package-relative; they are blind-directory-relative. A subsequent schema error exposed `line_kind`/`unit_orders` in one reader return. Normalizing those fields fixed the agreement check. A six-use chart assertion exposed the row 58 locator conflict; the final analysis records five explicit reference-key uses and retains the conflicting sixth prose locator. Those recorder failures occurred before creating the endpoint-record directory and changed no frozen witness. The first verification reported a missing registry evidence path because its own output had not yet been written; allowing that expected output fixed the check, and the failed check file remains preserved. A read-only Git ignore check initially rejected repository ownership; an ephemeral command option permitted the check without changing configuration. Pre-record text snapshots are ignored, so a small hash-checked JSON snapshot also preserves the documents for portable regeneration. No source search, download, full transcription rerun or large replay copy was made. Preservation covers 520 files; review paths and checks are in [README.md](README.md).
